configurations.name: prototypes
configurations.//: Static file server for the prototypes. Uses scripts/serve.py rather than `python3 -m http.server` because that one sends no Cache-Control, so the browser keeps serving a page you just edited — an edit looks like it did not land. serve.py sends no-store. Nothing depends on a specific port — no OAuth callbacks, webhooks or CORS — so autoPort lets it move if 4321 is taken. The script reads $PORT and falls back to 4321.
